verdict.rationale: Twilio documents a unified, real-time feed of all events streamed to multiple destinations (twilio-docs-8), and a hands-on user reports relying on Twilio's voicemail-to-webhook delivery with transcription (twilio-comm-15). Together these show outbound event delivery exists, but the pack never explicitly documents registrable HTTP webhook endpoints, event-type subscriptions, or payload and signature details. Missing for 10: explicit first-party webhook documentation (registering callback URLs, event catalog, signature validation, retries) and confirmation that Event Streams destinations include HTTP webhooks.
